claim: Homeowners: Larimer County Assessor price went up drastically?
summary: Homeowners: Larimer County Assessor price went up drastically? So I got the card from the Larimer County Assessor and the value of our home according to them went up about $60k; which seems to me to be an exorbitant amount. It was well over $30 what we just paid for the house in January 2015 and the prices are supposed to reflect June of 2014.
